applies_to.quote: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Forthcoming Instructions) Second Amendment Directions, 2026

answer.action: Ensure that items used for the computation of operational risk capital (ORC) comply with the updated Business Indicator constituents and calculation rules.
answer.action_quote: the banks shall ensure that items used for computation of ORC are in accordance with these Directions and consistent with the ‘description’ and ‘sub- items’ prescribed in Table VIII under Paragraph 29 of these Directions.

effective_date.quote: Chapter IV of the Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Forthcoming Instructions) Directions, 2025, on M inimum Capital Requirements for Operational Risk, along with amendments set out at Para 4 below, shall come into effect from April 1, 2027.

answer.amends: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Forthcoming Instructions) Directions, 2025
